name: Jointown Aesthetics Valley Co., Ltd.
summary: Jointown Aesthetics Valley Co., Ltd. offers technologies, materials, and services to beauty and health industry in China and internationally. It operates through Chemical Fiber Business, Medical Beauty Business, and Warehousing Business Segments. The company produces and sells lyocell fiber, viscose filament, glassine, chemical fiber pulp, refined cotton and other products. In addition, it engages in property management and warehousing services. The company was formerly known as Aoyuan Beauty Valley Technology Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Jointown Aesthetics Valley Co., Ltd. in February 2026.
